subject: English
passage: In his 1962 book The Structure of Scientific Revolutions, philosopher Thomas Kuhn first examined in detail his theory of "paradigm shifts"—the idea that the multiple theoretical models a scientist has accepted (mathematical, observational, experimental, etc.) ______ each hypothesis that scientist proposes within a research context.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation: Choice C is the best answer. The convention being tested is subject-verb agreement. The plural verb "influence" agrees in number with the plural subject "models."
